title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
statement: You may complete as many buy-sell transactions as you like. You may not hold more than one share. Return the maximum profit. Prices are given by day.
hints: Every upward difference can be captured by selling and buying again.
Add prices[i] - prices[i - 1] whenever it is positive.
A state machine with hold and cash also works and generalizes to the cooldown and fee variants.

approaches.name: State machine
approaches.explanation: cash and hold, updated each day.

editorial: Because you can transact every day, the optimal policy takes every positive consecutive difference and ignores the negative ones. A multi-day rise from a to c equals (b - a) + (c - b). Summing the pieces is the same profit as one trade across the rise.

examples.explanation: Buy at 1 sell at 5, buy at 3 sell at 6. Profit 7.
